topic.title: Spectral and Subspace Clustering
topic.area: Sparsity, Low-Rank Models, and Dimensionality Reduction
topic.overview: Clustering seeks useful groups without supplied labels, but the answer depends on the geometry and objective used to define similarity. These papers develop spectral, discriminative, manifold, and subspace approaches. Kernel eigenvectors, relaxed partition objectives, and robust regressions offer different ways to recover group structure beyond simple distance to a center.
topic.whyItMatters: Real datasets can contain curved groups, multiple views, noise, or correlated variables. Understanding which structure a clustering method assumes is essential before treating its output as a meaningful organization of the data.
topic.evolution: The early representatives compare self-organizing and information-based clustering. Work in the 2000s develops spectral kernels, maximum-margin objectives, and analyses of spectral limitations. Later examples add multiple nonredundant views, scalable manifold constraints, and robust variable clustering, showing increasing attention to alternative geometries and uncertainty rather than one universal partition.
openQuestions: How can users distinguish a stable cluster from an artifact of the similarity measure?
Which guarantees survive noisy or conflicting views of the same data?

papers.tldr: The framework combines centroid-free k-means, manifold-aware distances, and a balancing regularizer to improve clustering.

papers.title: Scalable Cross-View Sample Alignment for Multi-View Clustering with View Structure Similarity
papers.tldr: SSA-MVC learns cross-view sample correspondence through structural similarities and uses it to cluster data whose views are not fully aligned.

papers.title: Active Learning with Low-Rank Structure for Data Selection
papers.tldr: A low-rank data selection method builds small weighted subsets with conditional loss-preservation guarantees and reported improvements over sampling and clustering alternatives.

papers.title: Contractive Anchor Resolvent Diffusion for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
papers.tldr: CARD refines shared relationships for incomplete multi-view clustering without filling in missing views, scaling linearly with sample count at a fixed anchor budget.

papers.title: Discretely-Refined Multi-view Clustering via Aligned Anchor Learning
papers.tldr: DRMC improves multi-view clustering by feeding discrete cluster assignments back into the shared similarity graph through aligned embedding learning.

papers.title: Dual-Calibration Multi-View Clustering via Compact Anchor Learning
papers.tldr: DCMC jointly calibrates anchors and cluster assignments to improve multi-view clustering while preserving useful differences between views.

papers.title: Fine-to-Coarse Fairness-Informed Multi-View Clustering
papers.tldr: FCFMVC allocates clustering anchors according to cluster size and structure, improving representation while retaining linear time and space costs.

papers.title: Large Scale Manifold Balanced Clustering
papers.tldr: LMBC combines label-guided manifold construction, compact anchor distances, and a balance objective for scalable clustering.

papers.title: Nonconvex Low-Rank Tensor Representation with Deep Priors for Multiview Subspace Clustering
papers.tldr: The method combines nonconvex low-rank modeling and deep priors to improve multiview clustering while preserving global and local structure.

papers.title: Variable Clustering via Distributionally Robust Nodewise Regression
papers.tldr: A distributionally robust nodewise-regression formulation connects variable clustering to subspace clustering and supports an efficient optimization procedure.
